CustomField.formula:
IF( ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Completed") = False && Due_Date__c < TODAY(), IMAGE("/img/msg_icons/error16.png", "Past Due"), IF( ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Completed") = False && Due_Date__c -TODAY() <=14, IMAGE("/img/msg_icons/warning16.png", "Approaching Due Date"), "")
)
CustomField.label: Due Date Warning
